ma.reLaunch(Object object)

Close all pages and opens a page in the app.

Parameter

Object object

Attribute Type Default Value Mandatory or Not Description
url String Yes Path (code package path) of a page to be redirected to in the app. The path can be followed by a parameter. Separate a parameter and a path with a question mark (?), separate a parameter key and a parameter value with an equal sign (=), and separate different parameters with ampersands (&), for example, 'path?key=value&key2=value2'.
success Function No Callback function for a successful API call.
fail Function No Callback function for a failed API call.
complete Function No Callback function used when an API call is complete. (This callback function is used regardless of whether the API call succeeds or fails.)

Sample Code

ma.reLaunch({
  url: 'test?id=1'
});
// test
Page({
  onLoad(option) {
    console.log(option.query);
  }
});
